description: Counter styles of the author: @counter-style rules of every system (cyclic, symbolic, alphabetic, numeric, fixed, additive and extends), with a negative sign, padding, a range and a fallback, a prefix and a suffix, and the symbols() function of list-style-type in each type, and a name that is no style.

florui.css: @counter-style cy { system: cyclic; symbols: "@" "#" "%"; suffix: " "; } @counter-style sy { system: symbolic; symbols: "*" "+"; suffix: " "; } @counter-style al { system: alphabetic; symbols: "p" "q" "r"; suffix: " "; } @counter-style nu { system: numeric; symbols: "o" "i" "x"; suffix: " "; } @counter-style fx { system: fixed 3; symbols: "A" "B" "C"; suffix: " "; } @counter-style ad { system: additive; additive-symbols: 10 X, 5 V, 1 I; suffix: " "; } @counter-style bn { system: numeric; symbols: "0" "1"; negative: "(" ")"; pad: 5 "0"; suffix: " "; } @counter-style pf { system: extends decimal; prefix: "["; suffix: "] "; } @counter-style rg { system: cyclic; symbols: "A" "B"; range: 2 4; fallback: upper-roman; suffix: " "; } @counter-style ex { system: extends cy; prefix: "<"; } .wrap { position: relative; display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; align-items: flex-start; align-content: flex-start; width: 440px; height: 500px; background-color: #ffffff; font-size: 14px; line-height: 16px; } ol { display: block; width: 100px; margin: 0 0 0 4px; padding: 0; list-style-position: inside; } .cy { list-style-type: cy; } .sy { list-style-type: sy; } .al { list-style-type: al; } .nu { list-style-type: nu; } .fx { list-style-type: fx; } .ad { list-style-type: ad; } .bn { list-style-type: bn; } .pf { list-style-type: pf; } .rg { list-style-type: rg; } .ex { list-style-type: ex; } .i1 { list-style-type: symbols(cyclic "*" "+"); } .i2 { list-style-type: symbols("a" "b"); } .i3 { list-style-type: symbols(alphabetic "x" "y"); } .i4 { list-style-type: symbols(numeric "0" "1" "2"); } .i5 { list-style-type: symbols(fixed "A" "B"); } .i6 { list: none; list-style: symbols(cyclic "#") inside; } .un { list-style-type: no-such-style; } .o1, .o2, .o3 { padding-left: 30px; width: 60px; } .o1 { list-style-type: cy; } .o2 { list-style-type: pf; } .o3 { list-style-type: ad; }

classification.reason: The same font through two rasterizers, which differ in anti-aliasing on every glyph.
